State the purpose in one paragraph. Name the service sought, the
context, and the intended contract form.

# Background

State the background to the requirement. Name the current
arrangements and the problem they present.

# Scope of work

State the scope of the work. Name the services, the boundaries,
and the exclusions.

# Deliverables

List the deliverables with their acceptance criteria.

# Proposal requirements

State the contents required of the proposal: methodology,
resourcing, pricing, and timetable.

# Evaluation criteria

State the criteria and their weightings. Name the process and the
decision timescale.
